title: Rust: Rule 3 compression
description: Implement Rule 3 compression in Rust. Acceptance: compresses link-local IPv6/UDP, passes same vectors as Python.
close_reason: Spec Rule 3 is link-local RPL DIO (spec/03-adaptation.md 5.5); link-local IPv6+UDP+CoAP is Rule 0. Both compress paths exist in rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs (compress_rpl_dio, compress_coap RULE_LINK_LOCAL_COAP). Vectors rpl_dio and coap_linklocal. cargo test -p lichen-schc --test shared_vectors passed.
